Title: Burning Touch + Change of target + Obedience timing

Messages.Author: freakdrivr
Messages.Body:
What is the timing for the e cards listed in the subject?

When one plays Burning Touch (val) can the acting minion then play
Change of target right after? If one plays Burning Touch does
Obedience cancel the burn blood effect done by Burning Touch?

thanks,

jds

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
freakdrivr wrote:
>
> What is the timing for [Burning Touch + Change of target + Obedience]?

BT is playable at any time before the block succeeds.
CoT is playable once a block succeeds.
Obedience is playable once a block succeeds that would lead to combat.

> When one plays Burning Touch (val) can the acting minion then play
> Change of target right after? If one plays Burning Touch does
> Obedience cancel the burn blood effect done by Burning Touch?

Yes.
No.
